persons.name: Bhārasiṃha
persons.evidence: lipikaraḥ śrībhārasiṃho bhuvi⟪ḥ⟫ || sa dānaśau(ṇḍo) dharmmātmā bhaktibhāvanayā haraḥ | iha bhāgavataṃ puṇyaṃ lekhayām āsa

date.as_written: samvat 654 āṣāḍhakṛṣṇadvādaśyān tithau mṛgaśiranakṣatre dhruvayoge budhavāsare

notes: Bhārasiṃha is explicitly identified as the lipikara ('lipikaraḥ śrībhārasiṃho') and simultaneously as the commissioner ('lekhayām āsa').
